\section[il futuro]{il futuro — the future}

\label{lesson:IT-C138-il-futuro}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Italian for recently, then the Italian for to happen.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: il futuro}
\textbf{il futuro} — \textquotedblleft{}the future\textquotedblright{}. Italian builds the future on the infinitive: \textbf{parlare} becomes \textbf{parlerò} — \textquotedblleft{}I will speak\textquotedblright{} — then \textbf{parlerai}, \textbf{parlerà}.

\section[stasera]{stasera — this evening}

\label{lesson:IT-C138-stasera}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Italian for to happen, then the Italian for the future.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: stasera}
\textbf{stasera} — \textquotedblleft{}this evening\textquotedblright{}. The time word can stand first: \textbf{Stasera lavorerò.} — \textquotedblleft{}This evening I will work.\textquotedblright{} \textbf{Tra} a length of time gives \textquotedblleft{}in\textquotedblright{}: \textbf{tra due giorni} — \textquotedblleft{}in two days\textquotedblright{}.

\section[prevedere]{prevedere — to foresee, to forecast}

\label{lesson:IT-C138-prevedere}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Italian for this evening, then the Italian for a plan.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: prevedere}
\textbf{prevedere} — \textquotedblleft{}to foresee, to forecast\textquotedblright{}. \textbf{vedere} with \textbf{pre-}, \textquotedblleft{}before\textquotedblright{}: seeing a thing before it comes. The future of \textbf{essere} is irregular: \textbf{sarò}, \textbf{sarai}, \textbf{sarà}.

\section[organizzare]{organizzare — to organise}

\label{lesson:IT-C138-organizzare}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Italian for a plan, then the Italian for to foresee.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: organizzare}
\textbf{organizzare} — \textquotedblleft{}to organise\textquotedblright{}. A regular \textbf{-are} verb, so the future follows \textbf{parlare}: \textbf{Organizzerò tutto.} — \textquotedblleft{}I will organise everything.\textquotedblright{}
